objective: Al terminar escribes una carta o correo de queja formal: describes el problema con claridad, exiges una solución y cierras con firmeza y cortesía.

warmup.prompt_es: Una queja eficaz no es una bronca: es un texto ordenado, con datos, tono firme y una petición concreta. Si está bien escrita, aumenta mucho tus posibilidades de recibir una solución.

text: I am writing to complain about a laptop I purchased from your website on 12 October, which arrived on 20 October, eight days later than promised. I had been assured that the delivery would take three working days.

On opening the package, I discovered that the screen was cracked and the keyboard was missing several keys. Moreover, the battery does not hold a charge for more than twenty minutes, although the product description states that it lasts for ten hours. I contacted your customer service on three occasions, but each time I was told that someone would call me back. Nobody has done so.

I consider this unacceptable. I paid €1,200 for a product that is clearly defective, and I have been put to considerable inconvenience. I therefore request a full refund within seven days. Alternatively, I would accept a replacement of the same model, provided that it is delivered within five working days.
If I do not receive a satisfactory reply, I shall have no choice but to take the matter further. I attach photographs of the damage and a copy of the invoice.
I look forward to hearing from you.
input.es: Asunto: Queja sobre el pedido n.º 48215. Estimados señores: Les escribo para quejarme de un portátil que compré en su web el 12 de octubre y que llegó el 20 de octubre, ocho días más tarde de lo prometido. Me habían asegurado que la entrega tardaría tres días laborables. Al abrir el paquete descubrí que la pantalla estaba rota y al teclado le faltaban varias teclas. Además, la batería no aguanta la carga más de veinte minutos, aunque la descripción del producto afirma que dura diez horas. Contacté con su servicio de atención al cliente en tres ocasiones, pero cada vez me dijeron que alguien me llamaría. Nadie lo ha hecho. Lo considero inaceptable. Pagué 1.200 € por un producto claramente defectuoso y se me han causado considerables molestias. Por tanto solicito un reembolso completo en el plazo de siete días. Alternativamente, aceptaría un reemplazo del mismo modelo, siempre que se entregue en cinco días laborables. Si no recibo una respuesta satisfactoria, no me quedará más remedio que llevar el asunto más lejos. Adjunto fotografías de los daños y una copia de la factura. Quedo a la espera de sus noticias. Atentamente, M. Torres.

md_es: **Estructura de una carta de queja**
| Parte | Contenido | Frases útiles |
| **Asunto** | referencia clara | *Complaint regarding order No. …* |
| **Motivo** | qué y cuándo | *I am writing to complain about … I purchased on … * |
| **Descripción** | hechos ordenados | *On opening the package, I discovered … · Moreover, … · On three occasions, …* |
| **Impacto** | consecuencias | *I have been put to considerable inconvenience.* |
| **Petición** | qué exiges y plazo | *I therefore request a full refund within seven days.* |
| **Alternativa** | opción razonable | *Alternatively, I would accept a replacement, provided that …* |
| **Advertencia** | siguiente paso | *If I do not receive a satisfactory reply, I shall have no choice but to take the matter further.* |
| **Adjuntos** | pruebas | *I attach photographs of … and a copy of the invoice.* |
**Tono: firme pero cortés**
- ✔ *I consider this unacceptable.* · *I am extremely disappointed with … · I would be grateful if you could look into this as a matter of urgency.*
- ✘ *You are idiots.* / *Your company is a disaster.* (agresivo).
**Verbos de queja y petición**
- *complain about · demand · request · expect · insist on · require · claim a refund / compensation*.
- *I expect to receive … · I demand an explanation …* (más fuerte) · *I would appreciate it if you could …* (cortés).
**Conectores**
- *Moreover, Furthermore, In addition, Despite this, However, As a result, Therefore, Consequently*.
**Voz pasiva para hechos sin culpable claro**
- *The goods were damaged. · I was told that … · The package was delivered late.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *I want a refund now!* (tono) → ✔ *I would like to request a full refund within seven days.*
- ✘ *The product was broken since arrived.* → ✔ *The product was broken on arrival.*
- ✘ *I am complaining you.* → ✔ *I am writing to complain about …*
- ✘ *Please give me back my money.* (muy informal) → ✔ *Please refund the full amount.*
- ✘ *Explain me why.* → ✔ *I would like an explanation.*

**Ojo:** *Refund* (dinero devuelto) ≠ *replace* (cambiar). *Guarantee / warranty* (garantía). *Complain about something* a *someone*: *I complained to the manager about the noise.* *Damage* (incontable) vs *damages* (indemnización).
Pronunciación: *complaint* /kəmˈpleɪnt/ · *invoice* /ˈɪnvɔɪs/ · *defective* /dɪˈfektɪv/ · *warranty* /ˈwɒrənti/.

self_check_es: ¿Pides una compensación concreta y un plazo?
model_answer: I am writing to complain about my stay at your hotel from 3 to 6 May. On arrival, I was told that my sea-view room was not available, and I was given a room facing the car park. Moreover, the air conditioning did not work, and the noise from the kitchen prevented me from sleeping. I reported both problems to reception on two occasions, but nothing was done. I consider this unacceptable. I therefore request a refund of 50 per cent of the price within ten days. If I do not receive a satisfactory reply, I shall have no choice but to take the matter further. I attach a copy of my booking confirmation.
